# Acme Robotics — Company Overview

Acme Robotics is a fictional company founded in 2015, headquartered in Portland, Oregon.
We design and manufacture warehouse automation robots for mid-sized logistics companies.

## Products

Our flagship product is the **AcmeMover X1**, an autonomous mobile robot (AMR) that
transports pallets weighing up to 1,200 kilograms across warehouse floors. The X1 uses
LIDAR navigation and can operate for 14 hours on a single charge.

The **AcmeMover Lite** is a smaller unit designed for carrying totes and small parcels,
with a maximum payload of 80 kilograms and a 10-hour battery life.

## Support hours

Customer support is available Monday through Friday, 6 AM to 8 PM Pacific Time.
Emergency on-site support for enterprise customers is available 24/7 through the
Acme Priority line.
